about: The numbers behind the README's benchmark image and table: Drex Browser Use 0.1.6 in Loop mode and in its default mode, and Claude Code 2.1.289, all with Claude Haiku 5.5, on the same tasks, pass rule, 300-second clock and machine, 30 October 2026. passed/attempts count every scheduled try (MiniWoB++: a pass is a reward of exactly 1); usd is the model cost a try at API list prices (Drex Max $0.03 per million input tokens) and seconds the mean time a try, both up to the 300-second clock. Methodology: docs/evals.md. After editing, run node scripts/readme-assets.mjs.
title: Drex Browser Use against Claude Code, all on Claude Haiku 5.5
subtitle: Pass rate · model cost of 1,000 tasks · mean time a task · same tasks, 300 s clock and machine · 30 October 2026
footnote: Loop mode: the LLM drives, Drex Max acts · default mode: Drex Max acts, the LLM helps
